title: The Conservatory of Seasons
description: Guide a tiny mechanical gardener through seven suspended isometric gardens. Change seasons to freeze basins, grow liana bridges and power solar doors; push persistent fruit and planters, restore the central conservatory and enjoy a gentle visual finale. EN/FR/ES, keyboard, click and touch.
controls: Arrows, WASD or ZQSD: move and push
Click or tap an accessible tile to walk there
1/2/3/4 or seasonal buttons: winter, spring, summer, autumn
Z: undo; R: reset; H: progressive hint; M: sound
credits: Designed and developed with Kimi for Kimi Games.
Original Canvas artwork, mechanical gardener, interface, animation, cover and synthesized WebAudio created for this game.
No third-party runtime libraries or external assets.
